subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: After repairing persistence ordering, should OpenClaw permanently keep `agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` and the generic synchronous `onTaskTimeout` command-queue callback?
rationale: The stall can be repaired through narrower existing lifecycle ownership, while the proposed key and callback create durable operator and internal API contracts that code correctness alone cannot approve.

options.title: Narrow the contracts
options.body: Reuse existing timeout and abort/release ownership, keeping maintenance-specific fencing private where possible.

options.title: Approve new surfaces
options.body: Keep the config key and queue callback with explicit ownership, compatibility documentation, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause the timeout
options.body: Defer this behavior until maintainers choose a unified cancellable context-engine maintenance contract.

recommendation.title: Narrow the contracts
recommendation.body: Reuse existing timeout and abort/release ownership, keeping maintenance-specific fencing private where possible.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent current-main work owns the maintenance, queue-timeout, and SQLite session lifecycle integration affected by this decision.
